AUTH.name: User Registration & Login
AUTH.description: Verify account creation rules (valid / invalid classes, boundaries, several errors at once), login, lock-out after 5 wrong passwords and protection of pages that need a login.
pre: Application is running with an empty database.
User is on the Register or Log in page of VendorSetu.
post: A valid registration stores exactly one user with a hashed password; rejected input stores nothing.
After 5 consecutive wrong passwords the account stays locked even for the correct password.

SALE.name: Vendor Profile & Daily Sales Logging
SALE.description: Verify the business profile rules and that a vendor can log one valid sales entry per day, while invalid amounts, dates and payment modes are rejected without saving anything.
pre: Vendor 'Ramesh Kumar' (9876543210 / ramesh123) is registered and logged in.
His business profile is saved (unless the case says otherwise).
post: A valid entry is saved and counted in the 30-day summary; a rejected entry changes nothing.
A rejected profile is not saved.

TS.name: Trust Score Calculation
TS.description: Verify the 0-100 Trust Score formula, the risk band and the loan-eligibility cut-off of 40.
pre: Formula: Sales (active days / 30 x 40) + Repayment (on-time / due x 40, or 20 if no EMI is due yet) + Peer vouching (min(vouches, 3) / 3 x 10) + Tenure (min(years, 5) / 5 x 10), rounded.
Bands: 70-100 LOW RISK, 40-69 MEDIUM RISK, 0-39 HIGH RISK.
post: Score, band and eligibility are returned / displayed; no stored data is modified.

LOAN.name: Loan Application & Bank Review
LOAN.description: Verify progressive-tier loan application rules and the bank officer's approve / reject / disburse actions.
pre: Vendor 'Ramesh Kumar' (9876543210 / ramesh123): profile with 5 years of vending and a sale logged on each of the last 30 days, so his Trust Score is 40 + 20 + 0 + 10 = 70.
Bank officer 'Anil Sharma' (9123456780 / bank123) is registered.
post: An accepted application is stored as PENDING; approval and disbursal change its status and create the EMI schedule; rejected requests change nothing.
Only the owning vendor and bank officers can open a loan's page.

EMI.name: EMI Schedule & Repayment
EMI.description: Verify the EMI schedule, the repayment rules, loan closure (next tier unlocked) and the default check.
pre: Ramesh's Tier-1 loan #1 of Rs 15,000 at 12% p.a. for 12 months has been approved and disbursed today by the bank officer (unless the case says otherwise).
post: Paid installments are marked PAID (on time / late); when all 12 are paid the loan is CLOSED and Tier 2 (Rs 25,000) is unlocked.

defects.found: Typing 'nan' as a sale or loan amount crashed the app (HTTP 500 Internal Server Error); 'inf' as a loan amount gave a misleading message.
defects.cause: Python's float() accepts 'nan' and 'inf'. NaN passed every comparison and SQLite stored it as NULL in a NOT NULL column.
defects.fix: New helper parse_number() in database.py rejects values that are not finite numbers.

defects.found: A sale dated 1900-01-01 (or any old date) was accepted.
defects.fix: vendor.log_daily_sale() rejects entries more than 90 days old (MAX_BACKDATE_DAYS); FR-VEN-5 updated.

defects.found: Paying an EMI with amount 'nan' or 'inf' marked the installment PAID.
defects.cause: Same as DEF-01: the 'less than EMI' check is False for NaN.

defects.found: Names such as '12345' or a 300-character string were accepted at registration.
defects.cause: The name was only checked for being non-empty.
defects.fix: auth.validate_name(): letters, spaces, dots and apostrophes only, at most 50 characters; FR-AUTH-1 updated.

defects.found: A customer or municipal officer could open any vendor's loan page and see the amount and EMIs.
defects.cause: The /loan/<id> page only required a logged-in user and checked ownership for vendors only.
defects.fix: Only the owning vendor and bank officers may open a loan page (LOAN_VIEW_ROLES in app.py).

defects.found: Paying an EMI of a loan that does not exist, or of another vendor's loan, showed two error messages ('Loan not found | Loan not found', 'You can only pay your own loans | You can only view your own loans.').
defects.cause: The error page redirected to the loan page, which reported the same error again.
defects.fix: The pay_emi route redirects to the dashboard when the loan is missing or not the vendor's own.
